name: Supernerd
summary: Melbourne residential ISP, consumer arm of enterprise ISP Australia Internet Solutions (both led by MD Steven Wong); acquired by iiNet (early Sep 2011) and ~4,000 customers migrated to iiNet's network (AUSTRALIA INTERNET SOLUTIONS PTY. LTD., ACN 076 598 582).
